provenance: written by the maintainers for v1.2.0

evals.prompt: I screened 180 abstracts in. Which of them don't I have full text for, and how do I get them?
evals.expected_output: Runs fulltext_status.py, writes missing.csv and retrieval.md, reports totals and papers with no DOI

evals.prompt: Find legal open-access copies for my included studies.
evals.expected_output: Runs fulltext_status.py --resolve-oa with the user's email so Unpaywall supplies OA URLs, and does not use shadow libraries

evals.prompt: I downloaded 40 PDFs with names like 'download (7).pdf'. Which paper is which?
evals.expected_output: Runs match_pdf.py, which identifies each by DOI, PMID or title in its own text and reports matched, conflict or unmatched

evals.prompt: Attach the PDFs in my inbox to the right records in the library.
evals.expected_output: Runs match_pdf.py --attach, which copies only text-verified matches, refuses to overwrite, and logs a manifest
Explains the filename disagrees with the text, so the file is misnamed; renames or discards and never attaches it

evals.prompt: Prepare interlibrary loan requests for the papers my library does not have.
evals.expected_output: Uses retrieval.md ILL fields and the institution resolver link; reports unobtainable papers as not retrieved

evals.prompt: A few of my files are scans, and match_pdf.py reports filename-only.
evals.expected_output: Explains no text layer to verify; checks by eye, then reruns with --allow-filename-only, or OCRs first

evals.prompt: Which papers do I have to report as 'not retrieved' in my PRISMA flow?
evals.expected_output: Lists papers still missing after the routes, with reasons, for reports_not_retrieved; never summarizes them from abstracts as if read

evals.prompt: I have two copies of the same paper in my downloaded PDFs folder.
evals.expected_output: match_pdf.py reports duplicate and never overwrites; the user keeps the better copy

evals.prompt: Some included records have no DOI at all. How do I find their full text?
evals.expected_output: Reports the no-DOI count, searches by title and PMID in the worklist links, and matches downloads by title

evals.prompt: Search PubMed for papers on sepsis biomarkers.
evals.expected_output: Skill not used; paper-lookup or literature-review fits better

evals.prompt: Ask questions across the PDFs I already have.
evals.expected_output: Skill not used; paper-corpus-rag fits better

evals.prompt: Who has cited the original transformer paper, and how many times?
evals.expected_output: Skill not used; paper-lookup fits better
